meta.name: kotlin-specialist
meta.description: Provides idiomatic Kotlin implementation patterns including coroutine concurrency, Flow stream handling, multiplatform architecture, Compose UI construction, Ktor server setup, and type-safe DSL design. Use when building Kotlin applications requiring coroutines, multiplatform development, or Android with Compose. Invoke for Flow API, KMP projects, Ktor servers, DSL design, sealed classes, suspend function, Android Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform.

copy.tagline: 用惯用模式构建 Kotlin 应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Kotlin 开发 Android、后端或跨平台应用
copy.tagline_en: Build Kotlin applications with idiomatic patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building Kotlin apps for Android, backend, or multiplatform

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 Kotlin 专家流程工作：先分析架构，再输出惯用代码（数据模型、实现文件、测试文件），并确保协程取消、空安全等规范。涉及协程、Flow、KMP、Compose、Ktor、DSL 时，会加载对应参考指南。
howto.when: 当你提到 Kotlin、协程、KMP 等关键词，或要求开发协程、多平台或 Android+Compose 的 Kotlin 应用时触发。

say.text: 用协程实现一个带取消处理的 UserRepository 数据流。
say.note: 会给出 Flow 代码并检查结构化并发。

say.text: 为 Android 项目配置 KMP 共享模块，用 expect/actual。
say.note: 会给出多平台架构和平台实现。

say.text: 用 sealed class 设计登录页面的 UI 状态并写测试。
say.note: 会输出状态模型和测试文件。

howto.what_en: Claude works as a Kotlin specialist: analyzes architecture, then outputs idiomatic code (models, implementation, tests) ensuring coroutine cancellation and null safety. Loads relevant references for coroutines, Flow, KMP, Compose, Ktor, DSL.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Kotlin, coroutines, KMP, or similar keywords, or ask to build Kotlin apps using coroutines, multiplatform, or Android with Compose.

say_en.text: Implement a UserRepository flow with coroutines and cancellation.
say_en.note: Returns Flow code and checks structured concurrency.

say_en.text: Set up a KMP shared module for Android with expect/actual.
say_en.note: Provides multiplatform architecture and platform implementations.

say_en.text: Design login UI state with sealed class and add tests.
say_en.note: Outputs state model and test file.
